items.name: container is MP4 with one video and one audio stream
items.threshold: mp4; 1 video + 1 audio

items.name: video codec is H.264
picture is 1920x1080 with square pixels
30 frames per second, constant
items.threshold: r_frame_rate 30/1; average within 0.01; every frame within 1 ms of its slot

items.name: pixel format yuv420p, progressive
items.threshold: yuv420p, progressive

items.name: audio is AAC at 48 kHz
items.threshold: aac, 48000 Hz

items.name: faststart: the index (moov) stands before the data (mdat)
items.threshold: moov before mdat

items.name: the whole audio stream decodes without an error
the video stream is intact

measured.decoded: every packet read, key frames decoded

items.threshold: 0 errors

items.name: video and audio are equally long
items.threshold: difference at most 0.1 s

items.name: length equals the length the builder recorded
items.threshold: difference at most 0.1 s

items.name: colour is tagged BT.709, limited range
items.threshold: colour space bt709, range tv (players guess when the tag is missing)

items.name: integrated loudness at the builder's target
items.threshold: -16 LUFS +/- 1 LU (target from tools/video_build.py, loudnorm())

items.name: true peak below the ceiling
items.threshold: at most -1 dBTP (builder's target -1.5)

items.name: no clipping
items.threshold: sample peak below -0.1 dBFS, true peak below 0 dBTP, no flat tops

items.name: no silence that the storyboard does not explain
items.threshold: unexplained silence: warning above 2.5 s, failure above 6 s (level -30 dB; holds and the lead-in explain themselves and 0.75 s around them)

items.name: pace of every narration beat
items.threshold: 1.51 to 4.54 words/s and 8 to 19 letters/s for beats of 8 words or more; shorter beats: 4 to 38 letters/s and never above 10 words/s

items.name: every voice clip is a verified one
items.threshold: every clip has its .ok mark, made before the build, and is inside the pace bounds of C1; no beat fails C1; every beat is as long as its cached clips (within 0.06 s). A clip that left the cache is a warning

items.name: no raw code symbol and no emoji reaches the voice
items.threshold: 0 and 0 (symbols: RAW_SYMBOL of tools/video_build.py)

items.name: the sound follows the beat timeline
items.threshold: beat starts ascend from 1 s; every hold of 1.5 s or more is silent for at least 80 % of its length

items.name: the spoken text has not changed since the build
no black stretch
items.threshold: none of 0.5 s or more (key frames only: a black stretch between two key frames is not seen; --deep examines every frame)

items.name: no blank frame among the sampled frames
items.threshold: one frame every 30 s; each has at least 1 % edge pixels

items.name: subtitle file parses
items.threshold: every block has a number, a time line and text; numbers run 1, 2, 3; count as in .build.json

items.name: cues ascend and do not overlap
cues lie inside the video
items.threshold: first cue at 0 or later; last end at most 0.5 s after the video

items.name: no empty cue
lines are short enough to read
items.threshold: at most 2 lines of at most 42 characters (warning)

items.name: reading speed
items.threshold: at most 20 characters per second (warning)

items.name: no tag and no stage direction in the cue text
items.threshold: 0: [ANIMATION], [PAUSE], a direction in capitals in square brackets, ** (bold marker), backtick, HTML tag

items.name: the cues carry the whole narration
items.threshold: at least 100 % of the storyboard's narration, beat by beat and in order

items.name: first chapter starts at 0:00
at least 3 chapters
chapters ascend
every chapter is at least 10 s long
the last chapter starts before the end
every chapter has a title under 100 characters
title and description in youtube-metadata.md
items.threshold: title 1 to 100 characters; description with the chapter list pasted below it at most 5000

items.name: no angle bracket in title or description
items.threshold: YouTube rejects < and > in titles and descriptions (warning: check by hand before upload)

items.name: thumbnail exists, PNG or JPG
items.threshold: PNG or JPG (by content, not by name)

items.name: thumbnail is 1280x720
thumbnail is under 2 MB
items.threshold: under 2 MB (YouTube's limit)

items.name: the build report belongs to this MP4
items.threshold: same size in bytes; report written 0 to 180 s after the MP4; the builder's own checks passed

items.name: the video was built from the script as it is now
items.threshold: equal SHA-1

items.name: the storyboard is the one for this script
items.threshold: storyboard, script on disk and .build.json name the same script SHA-1 (warning if the storyboard file is newer than the build)

items.name: the storyboard has no warnings and no hints
items.threshold: 0 and 0

items.name: built with the animation layer
items.threshold: animated: true

items.name: narration from after the voice fix
items.threshold: the build started after the voice fix
